answers.drew: I have always appreciated entertainment as a way that anyone in the world, no matter what they are going through, can use this outlet as a way to escape from the biggest to smallest of problems. Creating and telling stories broadens the minds of those who may be succumbed to or stuck in their own bubble. Even those in the worst circumstances can have the world at their fingertips.
answers.seeking: Any other creatives in the entertainment space whether that be other screenwriters, or also those interested in production/directing. This would be extremely beneficial in finding people with their own specific talents that would not only be interesting to get to know, but helpful to connect with for future projects!
answers.inspiration: Julia Child. Although she was in  an entirely different profession than the one I aspire to be in, she taught me that leading with confidence, even if you are faking it, is always the correct choice over fear.
